issue.body:
# 7.12

- [x] Unknown/unmapped fields should show in source mode in the sidebar (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91697)
- [x] **Default column behavior is broken when switching between reading from source and fields API** (fixed with: https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/89826)
- [x] Fields filter doesn't work (elastic/kibana#88193); broken on current master as well ([PR](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/89837) open)
- [X] Unmapped fields are not shown (elastic/kibana#88192)
- [x] Unknown/unmapped fields should show in source mode in the sidebar (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91697)
- [X] Support for nested fields (ES [PR](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/67432) was merged, but not verified on Discover side) 
- [x] Date nanons are not properly displayed (ES [issue](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/67063))  -> workaround is that Kibana will request explicit date format with every date field (see https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/90415#issuecomment-774158585 for details)
- [X] Grouping multifields in the expanded documents view (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/85941)
- [X] Multi fields in the sidebar: removal button needs to be implemented (removing works only from the grid, not the field itself)
- [x] Fixing `fieldsFromSource` in the saved search Saved Objects (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91459)
- [x] Do not include unmapped fields in a search request when source filtering is enabled; might break ES otherwise https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91907
- [x] Disable source fetching ui setting on 7.12 and 7.x branch (to default to loading via fields API) @flash1293 https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/91986 https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/91988
- [x] Unmapped fields not shown in single doc viewer and context view https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91688
- [x] Context view retains wrong default column when toggling the UI setting (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91493)
- [x] Context view uses wrong default column when navigating there from new data grid (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91633)
- [x] Exclude unmapped fields if source filtering is enabled https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91907 (important for 7.12? I guess so) @majagrubic https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/91921#issuecomment-781652199
- [x] Date nanos in context view doesn't work https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/92005 (we definitely need this for 7.12) @flash1293
- [x] "Show unmapped fields" on by default (without visible switch) @majagrubic  PR https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/91735
- [x] Source column not shown correctly in embeddable https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91982 @flash1293 PR https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/91987
- [x] Field aliases don't properly #21705
- [x] Add back "Hide missing fields" switch @wylieconlon PR https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/91889
- [x] Reconstruct object root fields as columns in the data grid (https://github.com/elastic/kibana-team/issues/256#issuecomment-717435122) https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91953 @wylieconlon PR https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/91954
- [x] Default column not respected (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/92018) @majagrubic 

## In progress

* Testing

# Later

- [ ] Rollup index pattern doesn't work with source fetching #92362
- [x] `search_after` API does not accept `data_nanos` format of fields API necessarily (thus Discover context view might break) (requires https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/69192)
 - [ ] Add a server-side config value that will serve as a "master switch" and an override of the advanced setting toggle https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/91835
- [ ] Export to CSV still used _source implementation
- [ ] What happens with shared URLs that contain `_source` in the URL? We'd need to handle this scenario -> will go through the same migration system than saved objects do already
- [ ] create single Visualize button that would in case of one visualizable multi-fields visualize that instead of the parent field

# After removal of _source mode

- [ ] related to previous point: remove `_source` from meta fields in Advanced Settings (and remove _source from default columns)
- [ ] Remove _source from existing saved searches' columns (#91812)

# The 7.12 experience

There are two modes, controlled by the "Read fields from _source" advanced setting (`discover:searchFieldsFromSource`). If that setting is "off" (default in 7.12) fields will be read using the fields API (also called `fields mode` below), if it's "on" _source will be used (also called `source mode` below).

* **Document/_source column**:
  * `source mode` _source is an available column representing the _source of the field.
  * `fields mode` When the Fields API is used, the `_source` column is filtered from all views (in saved searches, default columns via advanced settings, ...). If _source was the only displayed column, it's replaced by the "Document" column showing all available fields in a flattened way
  * `fields mode` You can't mix the "document" column with other columns (as you can with `source mode`).
* **Runtime fields** (defined on the mapping):
  * `source mode` will show up in the field list, but will always appear empty inside the documents in any of the discover apps, unless they are of type `date` or `date_nanos` in which case they will work fine even in source mode.
  * `fields mode` will work as any other indexed field
* **Unmapped fields**:
  * `source mode` Unmapped fields will be shown (as they have been so far)
  * `fields mode` If fields API is used (the default), will be shown in the sidebar and in the documents. If source filtering (via the index pattern) is used, they won't show up anymore. In contrast to before unmapped leafs will be shown in the sidebar (see #92019)
  * Future plans: We plan to remove unmapped fields completely in 8.0 and instead other technologies to access that data (like runtime fields) need to be used.
* **Object fields**:
  * `source mode` Object fields (root and leaf fields) work as beforehand¹, only columns with array of objects will now be shown in one line instead of multi line JSON
  * `fields mode` Object roots won't be shown in the field list anymore (unless you have an old saved search containing one under "selected fields" so you can remove it). Leaf fields will now be correctly detected as having data, even when the document has an array of objects.
  * `fields mode` In the table root fields (which can only happen via manipulating the URL or opening existing saved searches which had them added) will be shown in a similar way to the "Document" field, i.e. a summary representation of that object:
  ![screenshot-20210222-142940](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/877229/108715229-d9e20580-751a-11eb-91ed-018b799d49b8.png)
  * `fields mode` Leaf fields will be working for all objects and if the document contained an array of objects, show the values of all objects in that array flattened:
  ![screenshot-20210222-143036](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/877229/108715249-e36b6d80-751a-11eb-9df0-e0413e6ed58f.png)
* **Nested fields**:
  * `source mode` Nested fields behave as beforehand. They behaved the same as object fields so far (see the footnote for more details).
  * `fields mode` The root of a nested field can be added from the field list and will show the structured JSON of that field in the document. Nested field columns now show the JSON correctly for all documents. Earlier it wouldn't show for documents that had only one object (instead of an array of objects) indexed into that field.
  * `fields mode` If you have a saved search with a nested leaf field as a column (which could have been possible earlier, if there was a document having only one nested document and not an array) this will show as empty now. We want to have this behavior going forward since we assume the nested mapping type is only used when you index an array of objects, since it otherwise does not make much sense to be used.

¹ The sidebar shows the object field (aka root) with an unknown icon if at least one document loaded has an array of objects for that object field, otherwise the root field won't be shown. The leaf fields will be shown with their correct field icons. Leaf fields that do not appear in any document or only in documents that have arrays of objects for this object field, will NOT appear in the field list unless "Hide missing fields" is switched off, e.g. in the screenshot below `user.age` which only appears in the first document that has an array of users will not appear in the field list by default. In the table root fields as columns will show the JSON of the fields content ONLY if that document contained an array of objects and will be empty otherwise. Leaf fields as columns will ONLY show values if the document did NOT contain an array of objects and stay empty otherwise:

![screenshot-20210222-121550](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/877229/108715202-d2baf780-751a-11eb-8c64-14829630b4bc.png)

### Known issues 7.12

* Environments that are running CCS with mixed versions of ES will not show all fields in Discover, but only the fields from the ES versions that support the Fields API.
* Surrounding document view does fail with date_nanos with a custom formatter (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/92595)
* Rollup v1 index patterns are not working in Discover when in `source mode` (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/92362)
* Runtime fields not working in CSV export (https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/81079)

body:
Thanks for raising this. For now maybe `fields` could ignore the `_type` field it does for all other metadata fields. We meant to ignore `_type`, but there's a bug in how we detect metadata fields -- I think we miss `_type` since it was removed in 8.x.

We have a dedicated issue on how to return metadata fields generally: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/63569. It'd be great to get your feedback there if you have thoughts.

issue.title: Fix error when requesting _type from fields option.

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
For 8.0 indices, the 'fields' option would throw an error when '_type' is
requested. Since '_type' was removed in 8.0, it should instead behave as if the
field didn't exist, where we don't error but return no values.

Closes #68311.

body:
Here's a summary from digging in further:
* On the 7.x branch, and for 7.x indices on 'master' we correctly ignore the `_type` field.
* On 'master' with 8.x indices, we throw an error on `_type`. Instead we should behave as if the field didn't exist, where we don't error but return no values.

I opened #68413 to fix this oversight on 'master' and will close this out once it's merged. If you need a change to how metadata fields like `_type` are handled in general, let's discuss on #63569.

Update: that PR was closed in favor of #68564.

issue.title: Remove support for _type in searches

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Types are no longer allowed in requests in 8.0, so we can remove support for
using the `_type` field within a search request.

Relates to #41059.
Closes #68311.
